import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXR = 11;
    static final int MAXN = 1000;
    static final int MAXM = 100100;
    static final int oo = 1 << 29;

    static int[] ady = new int[2 * MAXM + 5];
    static int[] flow = new int[2 * MAXM + 5];
    static int[] cap = new int[2 * MAXM + 5];
    static int[] nxt = new int[2 * MAXM + 5];
    static int[] last = new int[MAXN + 5];
    static int[] now = new int[MAXN + 5];
    static int[] lev = new int[MAXN + 5];
    static int[] cola = new int[MAXN + 5];
    static int E, n, s, t, enq, deq;

    static int R;
    static String[] m1, m2;
    static int[][][] tim = new int[2][][];
    static int[][][] nod = new int[2][][];

    static int[] movI = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int[] movJ = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static class Par {
        int first, second;
        Par(int f, int s) { first = f; second = s; }
    }

    static void init_maxflow(int nn, int ss, int tt) {
        n = nn;
        s = ss;
        t = tt;
        E = 2;
        Arrays.fill(last, 0, n + 1, 0);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        ady[E] = v; flow[E] = 0; cap[E] = c; nxt[E] = last[u]; last[u] = E++;
        ady[E] = u; flow[E] = 0; cap[E] = 0; nxt[E] = last[v]; last[v] = E++;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(lev, 0, n + 1, 0);
        enq = deq = 0;
        cola[enq++] = s;
        lev[s] = 1;
        while (deq < enq && lev[t] == 0) {
            int u = cola[deq++];
            for (int e = last[u]; e != 0; e = nxt[e]) {
                int v = ady[e];
                if (lev[v] == 0 && flow[e] < cap[e]) {
                    lev[v] = lev[u] + 1;
                    cola[enq++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return lev[t] != 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int F) {
        if (u == t) return F;
        for (int e = now[u]; e != 0; e = now[u] = nxt[e]) {
            int v = ady[e];
            if (lev[u] < lev[v] && flow[e] < cap[e]) {
                int f = dfs(v, Math.min(F, cap[e] - flow[e]));
                if (f != 0) {
                    flow[e] += f;
                    flow[e ^ 1] -= f;
                    return f;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int F = 0, f = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            System.arraycopy(last, 0, now, 0, n + 1);
            while ((f = dfs(s, oo)) != 0) F += f;
        }
        return F;
    }

    static boolean can_move(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < R && j < R && m1[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && m1[i].charAt(j) != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs2(int i, int j, int cc) {
        tim[cc] = new int[R][R];
        tim[cc][i][j] = 1;
        Queue<Par> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new Par(i, j));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Par cur = q.poll();
            int ci = cur.first;
            int cj = cur.second;
            if (cc == 1 && tim[0][ci][cj] != 0 && tim[0][ci][cj] <= tim[1][ci][cj]) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int ii = ci + movI[k];
                int jj = cj + movJ[k];
                if (can_move(ii, jj) && tim[cc][ii][jj] == 0) {
                    tim[cc][ii][jj] = tim[cc][ci][cj] + 1;
                    q.add(new Par(ii, jj));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        m1 = new String[R];
        m2 = new String[R];
        nod[0] = new int[R][R];
        nod[1] = new int[R][R];

        int zi = 0, zj = 0;
        int nodeCount = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            m1[i] = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                char c = m1[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z') {
                    zi = i;
                    zj = j;
                } else if (c != 'Y') {
                    nodeCount++;
                    nod[0][i][j] = nodeCount;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            m2[i] = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                char c = m2[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    nodeCount++;
                    nod[1][i][j] = nodeCount;
                }
            }
        }

        nodeCount++;
        s = 0;
        t = nodeCount;
        init_maxflow(nodeCount, s, t);

        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                char c1 = m1[i].charAt(j);
                char c2 = m2[i].charAt(j);
                if (c1 != 'Z' && c1 != 'Y') {
                    add_edge(s, nod[0][i][j], c1 - '0');
                }
                if (c2 != 'Z' && c2 != 'Y') {
                    add_edge(nod[1][i][j], t, c2 - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        bfs2(zi, zj, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < R; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < R; j++) {
                char c1 = m1[i].charAt(j);
                if (c1 > '0' && c1 <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j, 1);
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < R; ii++) {
                        for (int jj = 0; jj < R; jj++) {
                            char c2 = m2[ii].charAt(jj);
                            if (c2 > '0' && c2 <= '9') {
                                if (tim[1][ii][jj] != 0 &&
                                    (tim[0][ii][jj] == 0 || tim[0][ii][jj] >= tim[1][ii][jj]) &&
                                    tim[1][ii][jj] - 1 <= T) {
                                    add_edge(nod[0][i][j], nod[1][ii][jj], oo);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
